# Wildfire Trackers

> > Real-time tracking of active wildfires and prescribed burns across the United States with live fire perimeter data, containment status, and smoke monitoring.

Wildfire Trackers aggregates data from InciWeb, CAL FIRE, and NOAA to provide comprehensive wildfire monitoring across US states. The platform offers detailed tracking of individual fires with statistics on acres burned, containment progress, and nearby fire activity.

## Key Topics

- Real-time wildfire tracking
- Active fires
- Fire containment status
- Fire perimeter mapping
- Acres burned
- Prescribed burns
- Smoke monitoring
- 2026 wildfire season
- State-level fire tracking
- Fire statistics
- Nearby fires
- InciWeb data
- CAL FIRE integration
- NOAA weather data
- Individual fire details

## National & Regional Tracking

- [Today's Active Wildfires](https://wildfiretrackers.com/f): Real-time US wildfire tracking map with active fire data across states
- [United States Wildfires/Smoke Today](https://wildfiretrackers.com/f/united-states/wildfires): Comprehensive US wildfire tracking map with real-time fire and smoke data
- [About Wildfire Trackers](https://wildfiretrackers.com/f/about): Overview of Wildfire Trackers platform aggregating InciWeb, CAL FIRE, NOAA data

## State-Level Wildfire Tracking

- [2026 Texas Wildfires](https://wildfiretrackers.com/f/united-states/texas/wildfires): Texas wildfire tracking with Bright Lights, Old Mill, Twins fires
- [2026 Nebraska Wildfires](https://wildfiretrackers.com/f/united-states/nebraska/wildfires): Nebraska wildfire tracking with Cottonwood, Morriel, Anderson Bridge fires
- [2026 Wyoming Wildfires](https://wildfiretrackers.com/f/united-states/wyoming/wildfires): Wyoming wildfire tracking including Garden Circle, Wyopo, Qury fires
- [2026 Colorado Wildfires](https://wildfiretrackers.com/f/united-states/colorado/wildfires): Colorado active wildfire tracking including Morriel, French Creek fires
- [2026 South Dakota Wildfires](https://wildfiretrackers.com/f/united-states/south-dakota/wildfires): South Dakota wildfire tracking including Coyote Flats, Victoria Lake fires
- [2026 Florida Wildfires](https://wildfiretrackers.com/f/united-states/florida/wildfires): Florida wildfire tracking with National, Silver Lake, 139 fires data
- [2026 Oklahoma Wildfires](https://wildfiretrackers.com/f/united-states/oklahoma/wildfires): Oklahoma wildfire and prescribed burn tracking for 2026 season
- [2026 Arkansas Wildfires](https://wildfiretrackers.com/f/united-states/arkansas/wildfires): Arkansas wildfire and prescribed burn tracking for 2026 season

## Active Fire Details

- [Bright Lights Fire Active Wildfire](https://wildfiretrackers.com/f/fires/txtxs-bright-lights-fire-f988): Detailed tracking of Bright Lights Fire near Claude, Texas
- [Garden Circle Fire Active Wildfire](https://wildfiretrackers.com/f/fires/wildfire-2026-garden-circle-3b58): Detailed tracking of Garden Circle Fire near Evansville, Wyoming
- [Coyote Flats Fire Active Wildfire](https://wildfiretrackers.com/f/fires/sdbkf-coyote-flats-fire-6064): Detailed tracking of Coyote Flats Fire in Colonial Pine Hills, South Dakota
- [Cottonwood Fire Active Wildfire](https://wildfiretrackers.com/f/fires/nenes-cottonwood-fire-b799): Detailed tracking of Cottonwood Fire near Curtis, Nebraska
- [139 Fire Active Wildfire](https://wildfiretrackers.com/f/fires/wildfire-2026-139-d235): Detailed tracking of 139 Fire near Hosford, Florida

## Prescribed Burns

- [Rx Mcwa Linson Fire Active Wildfire](https://wildfiretrackers.com/f/fires/wildfire-2026-rx-mcwa-linson-d2c9): Detailed tracking of Rx Mcwa Linson prescribed burn near Broken Bow, Oklahoma
- [Rx Buck Creek Fire Active Wildfire](https://wildfiretrackers.com/f/fires/wildfire-2026-rx-buck-creek-e839): Detailed tracking of Rx Buck Creek prescribed burn near Broken Bow, Oklahoma

## Local Area Tracking

- [Wildfires/Smoke near Curtis, Nebraska, United States Today](https://wildfiretrackers.com/f/us-ne-curtis/fires): Wildfire and smoke tracking near Curtis, Nebraska including Cottonwood Fire
